items.title: Henry "Pickle" Jackson Interview, 1961-08-09
items.q: This little saxophone player used to be in his band. At that time. Earl Barnes. He was in the band.

ctx.x: This little saxophone player used to be in his band. At that time. Earl Barnes. He was in the band. Was he killed in this? No, he left. The band left without him.
The other band? No. The other band was from Chicago.
